text.p: Italian car maker Fiat said on Thursday it was recalling 80,000 Brava/Bravo 1.4-litre saloon models to replace a brake component after problems were encountered with the car in Germany.

"Fiat Auto has decided to initiate a recall campaign on Fiat Bravo and Brava 1.4 models, replacing the brake servo depression pipe. This modification has already been applied to vehicles in production," Fiat said in a statement.
A spokesman for Fiat said the recall of every 1.4 version of the Bravo/Bravo car range, launched on the market in September 1995, was probably the biggest of its kind the group had ever carried out.
"Following a small number of cases in Germany of the progressive hardness of the brake pedal of the Fiat Brava 1.4, Fiat Auto immediately implemented a technical inquiry," it said.

The company said there had been isolated instances where the brake pedal had stiffened if the car was driven without interruption at top speed over long distances in severely cold weather. Drivers had not been in any danger, Fiat said.
No incidents were reported in any country other than Germany and the car's right-hand drive version, sold in Britain, did not appear to be affected, a company spokesman said.

"Research shows that this phenomenon manifests itself solely in particular climatic conditions on vehicles repeatedly driven at the maximum speed for long periods and without intermediate deceleration," the statement said.
"No other market has reported this phenomenon," it added.
Fiat said this was not a safety-related problem because if there was "a reduction, or at worst, loss of servo-assistance, the hydraulic braking system maintains its full efficiency."

Other recent recalls involved a small number of Punto models in July 1995 to check the anti-lock braking system (ABS) and of Alfa Romeo convertible and GTV models in January of the same year to check seatbelt fittings, the spokesman said.
The Brava/Bravo range spearheads Fiat's assault on an area of the car market which has for years been dominated by the Volkswagen Golf.
